goal: Treat transient SSH disconnects during installer readiness as retryable, including a disconnect after successful early probes; prevent false permanent failure and deletion during an intentional reboot.
context: Live observation after bootstrap fix7a19f0b: S1 deployment5ad55938 had reboot scheduled14:51:15Z, OS readiness failed SSH_DISCONNECTED14:51:18Z, classified nonretryable by ReadinessCollector explicit whitelist and finalized/deleted. DiagnosticRetryable already regards SSH_DISCONNECTED transient. Add shared narrow SSH retry classification; preserve permanent host-key/config errors, real root/package/disk errors, original bounded attempt/backoff. For mid-collection transient loss stop further probes/remediation and return BLOCKED retryable instead of interpreting blank root/package results as permanent. No false READY. Tests simulate connection reset/broken pipe/EOF and recovery after reboot, mid-probe loss, permanent key failure, no unsafe automatic remediation; full suite/race and prior installer bootstrap isolated DB regressions. No cloud resources created for tests. Fix applies existing workflow future replacements naturally. API plan/review followed by atomic deployment with rollback; settings unchanged.
commit_message: fix(provisioning): retry SSH loss during reboot readiness
